_readme: There is no single job-postings source for private mid-size companies, so each
company is its own integration. That is the whole difficulty of this evidence
family, and this file is where the difficulty is made visible: a company either
has a working adapter here or it is an explicit, reported coverage gap.
'ats' selects the adapter. 'careers_url' is the human-checkable citation that goes
into source_url — always the company's own page, never the ATS internals.
Entries under 'gaps' are companies with no working adapter yet. They are processed
every run, produce no observations, and are counted in the coverage report. Never
delete a gap to make a run look clean.

C0005.discovered: 2026-08-24 — careers page links directly to recruiting.paylocity.com job details

C0007.discovered: 2026-08-24 — iCIMS portal; company also lists JazzHR and Paycor postings not covered here

gaps.C0001: Midmark — careers page at midmark.com/about-us/careers returns 200 but lists no ATS in server-rendered HTML; postings appear to be JS-loaded. Needs a rendered-DOM fetch or the underlying ATS endpoint identified.
gaps.C0002: Mack Group — mack.com/careers 404s. Correct careers URL not yet identified for the Mack Molding operating entity.
gaps.C0003: Duke Manufacturing — dukemfg.com/careers returns 200, no ATS detected in server-rendered HTML. Same JS-loaded pattern as Midmark.
gaps.C0004: Western Express — westernexp.com/careers 404s. Large truckload carriers typically run driver recruiting on Tenstreet or DriverReach, which are separate from any corporate ATS; needs discovery.
gaps.C0008: CT Logistics — no careers source configured yet. Restored to the buyer universe 2026-09-01; discovery attempts it like any other company. (Was 'excluded from the research universe; not attempted', which is no longer true.)
